fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Pore-Passivation Electrochemical/Thevenin Hybrid with Thermal ODE
description: 0D aprotic Li-O2 cell. Discharge forms insulating Li2O2 that progressively fills/clogs the porous air-cathode (capacity cut off at pore saturation), large ORR/OER round-trip voltage gap (~1 V hysteresis), thermal ODE via scipy.solve_ivp.
source: Laoire et al. (2010) J. Electrochem. Soc. 157(7), A821; Abraham & Jiang (1996) J. Electrochem. Soc. 143, 1; Viswanathan et al. (2011) J. Chem. Phys. 135, 214704; Lu et al. (2013) Nat. Chem. 5, 527; Read (2002) J. Electrochem. Soc. 149, A1190; Sandhu, Fellner & Brooks (2007) J. Power Sources 164, 365 (pore-clogging discharge model); Bao et al. (2015) J. Electrochem. Soc. 162, A1602

unit.name: Aprotic Li-O2 cell (Li metal anode / carbon porous air cathode, TEGDME/DMSO electrolyte)

E_eq_ref.note: Equilibrium (thermodynamic) cell potential of 2Li + O2 -> Li2O2 at T_ref; OCV anchor
E_eq_ref.source: Lu et al. (2013) Nat. Chem. 5, 527; Viswanathan et al. (2011)

capacity_ref.note: Nominal cell capacity (reused from F1); discharge truncated earlier by pore saturation

Q_pore_max.note: Charge that can be passed in discharge before Li2O2 saturates the cathode pores (theoretical pore-fill capacity)
Q_pore_max.source: Sandhu et al. (2007) J. Power Sources 164, 365

pore_cutoff_frac.note: Fraction of pore volume filled by Li2O2 at which transport collapses and discharge ends (sudden death)
pore_cutoff_frac.source: Sandhu et al. (2007); Bao et al. (2015)

R_ref.note: Base internal resistance at T_ref (Li2O2 insulating film), reused from F1

tau_ct.note: Charge-transfer/double-layer RC relaxation time constant (Thevenin branch)

R_ct_ref.note: Charge-transfer (polarization) resistance of the RC branch at T_ref

eta_orr.note: Sluggish ORR (discharge) kinetic overpotential at reference rate

eta_oer.note: Sluggish OER (charge) kinetic overpotential at reference rate; OER >> ORR drives ~1 V round-trip gap
eta_oer.source: Lu et al. (2013); McCloskey et al. (2011) J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 2, 1161

i_ref.note: Reference current at which eta_orr/eta_oer are quoted (Tafel anchor)

tafel_slope.note: Effective Tafel slope for ORR/OER current dependence

k_passiv.note: Maximum additional discharge overpotential from Li2O2 film passivation as pores fill
k_passiv.source: Sandhu et al. (2007); Bao et al. (2015)

E_a.note: Activation energy of ORR/OER kinetics (Arrhenius on R and eta), reused from F1
E_a.source: Viswanathan et al. (2011); Laoire et al. (2010)

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient (most negative of common chemistries), reused from F1
dOCV_dT.source: Viswanathan et al. (2011); Lu et al. (2013)

n_e.note: Electrons per O2 in 2Li + O2 -> Li2O2

m_cell.note: Lumped cell thermal mass (small coin/pouch Li-O2 cell)

current_A.note: Positive=discharge, negative=charge; Li-air limited to low rates
